colour_sources.name: Two Thin Coats Dragon’s Gold — Arcturus / GERInFact composite gradient
colour_sources.method: Review proposal for SKU 10044 only: retain Arcturus #CDA24E as the representative hex and bright stop; use GERInFact #4F442C as the dark stop. The official PDF is visual reference for a shadow-to-highlight interpretation, not the source of these numeric endpoints. Metallic type is documented at https://transatlantisgames.com/product-list/. Provenance and the reference comparison are in reports/arcturus-review/.
